{{scholia|Q21339469|author=Alan W. Archer}}
'''Alan W. Archer''' (born 1930)<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Archer, Alan W. {{!}} International Plant Names Index|url=https://www.ipni.org/a/30946-1|access-date=2021-01-21|website=www.ipni.org}}</ref> is a mycologist and taxonomist. He is currently (January 2021) an honorary [[research associate]] at [[Royal Botanic Garden, Sydney|Royal Botanic Gardens Sydney]].  He uses [[chemotaxonomy]] as well as morphological features in taxonomy and to devise [[identification key|key]]s, most recently for the genus ''[[Pertusaria]]'' in the Australasia region.<ref name=herb>{{cite web|url=https://www.rbgsyd.nsw.gov.au/science/our-science-staff/dr-alan-w-archer|publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Sydney|title=Dr. Alan W. Archer}}</ref><ref name="Archer1997">{{cite book |last1=Archer |first1=A W |title=The Lichen Genus Pertusaria in Australia |date=1997 |publisher=Schweizerbart |isbn=978-3-443-58048-3 |pages=249}}</ref>

During his career he has characterised and revised over 100 fungal taxa. He is an authority on the family [[Graphidaceae]] from the Australia - Pacific region and characterised ''[[Carbacanthographis salazinica]]'' and ''[[Phaeographis salazinica]]''.<ref name="Archer2005">{{cite book |last1=Archer |first1=A W |title=The Lichen Family Graphidaceae in Australia |date=2005 |publisher=Bibliotheca Lichenologica |isbn=9783443580735 |pages=249}}</ref><ref name="Lücking-et-al2009">{{cite journal |last1=Lücking |first1=Robert |last2=Archer |first2=Alan W |last3=Aptroot |first3=André |title=A world-wide key to the genus Graphis (Ostropales: Graphidaceae) |journal=The Lichenologist |date=2009 |volume=41 |issue=4 |pages=363–452 |doi=10.1017/s0024282909008305|s2cid=85421300 }}</ref> He was also the first to characterise several members of the genus ''[[Pertusaria]]'', ''[[Pertusaria ambigua]]'' ''[[Pertusaria epacrospora]]'', ''[[Pertusaria guineabissauensis]]'', ''[[Pertusaria salazinica]]'', ''[[Pertusaria sipmanii]]'' and . An advanced search of the [[Mycobank]] database shows that he has authored some 101 fungi taxa,<ref name="myco">{{cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Search for taxa with (author contains "A.W.Archer")|url=https://www.mycobank.org/page/Advanced%20names%20search|archive-url=|archive-date=|accessdate=2021-01-21|website=www.mycobank.org}}</ref> including ''[[Pertusaria xylophyes]]''.''<ref name="pert">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Index Fungorum - Fungal Name Author Details: Alan W. Archer|url=https://www.indexfungorum.org/names/AuthorDetails.asp?ID=8013|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-21|website=www.indexfungorum.org}}</ref>'' (See also [[:Category:Taxa named by Alan W. Archer|Taxa named by Alan W. Archer]].)

The standard [[List of botanists by author abbreviation (A)|author abbreviation]] '''A.W.Archer''' is used to indicate this person as the author when [[Author citation (botany)|citing]] a [[botanical name]].<ref name=":0" />
